frontmatter.name: routr-ai
frontmatter.description: Build AI features with Vercel AI SDK (chat, agents, RAG, tools). Use when: chatbot, LLM, streaming, embeddings, tool calling, AI SDK, RAG. Not for: multi-agent architecture or eval harness (→ routr-agents); chat UI styling only (→ routr-frontend).

frontmatter.name: routr-agents
frontmatter.description: Design multi-agent systems, agent loops, and eval harnesses. Use when: building agents, agent operating loop, research/self-correction loop, harness, memory, tools, context engineering, eval loop. Not for: a single AI SDK chat/RAG feature (→ routr-ai).

frontmatter.name: routr-refactor
frontmatter.description: Improve code structure without changing behavior. Use when: refactor, tech debt, extract module, clean up code, restructure. Not for: fixing bugs or changing behavior (→ routr-debug / routr-ship).

frontmatter.name: routr-perf
frontmatter.description: Performance: Core Web Vitals, bundle size, re-renders, slow APIs, N+1 queries, memory leaks, caching. Use when: slow page, high INP, big bundle, leak growing. Not for: wrong output (routr-debug), one query (routr-database), redesign (routr-frontend), animating (routr-motion).

frontmatter.name: routr-ship
frontmatter.description: Make a small fix, verify it, and commit or open a PR. Use when: 'fix this', patch, tests must pass, ready to ship, commit, open PR, merge this change. Not for: unknown root cause (→ routr-debug); building new UI (→ routr-frontend).

frontmatter.name: routr-explore
frontmatter.description: Explain how the codebase works without changing code. Use when: 'how does X work', architecture, onboarding, where is this defined, walk me through. Not for: a specific bug (→ routr-debug); changing code (→ routr-ship).

frontmatter.name: routr-frontend
frontmatter.description: Build or redesign UI (pages, components, design system). Use when: new screen, landing page, layout, Tailwind, shadcn, 'make it look good', redesign, dashboard UI. Not for: animation (→ routr-motion); logic bugs (→ routr-debug); multi-screen feature with no spec (→ routr-plan).

frontmatter.name: routr-review
frontmatter.description: Review a PR or diff for bugs, style, and React best practices. Use when: code review, 'review my changes', before merge, PR feedback. Not for: writing the fix yourself (→ routr-ship).

frontmatter.name: routr-security
frontmatter.description: Security pass on code, auth, and cloud rules. Use when: security audit, vulnerabilities, RLS, secrets in code, 'is this secure'. Not for: non-security bugs (→ routr-debug).

frontmatter.name: routr-deploy
frontmatter.description: Deploy to Vercel, preview environments, or app stores. Use when: deploy, go live, preview URL, production release, EAS submit, TestFlight; deploy-then-verify requests start here. Not for: writing the code (→ routr-ship); QA of an already-live site (→ routr-qa).

frontmatter.name: routr-plan
frontmatter.description: Plan before coding: brainstorm, PRD, stress-test ideas. Use when: new multi-screen feature, spec, PRD, 'grill my plan', brainstorm, architecture decision, before big implementation. Not for: writing code now (→ routr-ship); sketching UI layout or visuals (→ routr-frontend).

frontmatter.name: routr-integrate
frontmatter.description: Integrate a third-party library using up-to-date docs. Use when: 'how do I use X', SDK setup, API syntax, version migration, configure library. Not for: internal codebase exploration (→ routr-explore); debugging a library error (→ routr-debug).

frontmatter.name: routr-mobile
frontmatter.description: Build Expo or React Native apps (screens, navigation, native UI). Use when: mobile app, Expo, React Native, iOS, Android, native screen. Not for: web-only UI (→ routr-frontend); EAS build/submit, TestFlight or Play Store release (→ routr-deploy).

frontmatter.name: routr-marketing
frontmatter.description: Marketing copy, SEO audits, and growth content. Use when: landing copy, SEO, meta tags, ads, CRO, App Store listing, blog post, growth. Not for: building the landing page UI (→ routr-frontend).

frontmatter.name: routr-database
frontmatter.description: SQL, Postgres, Supabase schema and queries. Use when: migrations, RLS, slow queries, database design, Supabase. Not for: ORM or client-library setup (→ routr-integrate); wrong query results, cause unknown (→ routr-debug).
